definition: OMIM #621201 designates Neurodevelopmental Disorder with Dysmorphic Facies, Brain Anomalies, and Seizures (NEDFBS), an autosomal recessive genetic disorder caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the GTF3C3 gene on chromosome 2q33. The condition is clinically characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, microcephaly, characteristic facial dysmorphisms, seizures, and structural central nervous system anomalies including brain atrophy with predominant cerebellar involvement, hypoplasia of the frontal lobes, and simplified gyral patterns.

source.title: Biallelic variants in GTF3C3 encoding a subunit of the TFIIIC2 complex are associated with neurodevelopmental phenotypes in humans and zebrafish
source.quote: Herein, we describe the identification of biallelic variants in GTF3C3, which encodes a key component of the TFIIIC subunit, in four patients from three unrelated families of different ethnicities collected through GeneMatcher. The patients exhibited microcephaly, developmental delay, intellectual disability and distinctive dysmorphic facies that appear recognizable in very young children. Their brain imaging showed brain atrophy with predominant cerebellar involvement, as well as hypoplasia of the frontal lobes and one patient had moderate to severe simplified gyral pattern. Seizures were observed in half of the patients.
